title: Toward a Compositional Knowledge Architecture for a Shared Organizational Cortex
abstract: arXiv:2611.05753v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Organizations accumulate evidence in conversations, documents, decisions and relationships, but they act on interpretations: judgements assembled from several observations, resting on assumptions, and revised as circumstances change. Existing retrieval, knowledge graphs and agent memory keep the records and lose the interpretation. We propose a four-layer architecture, Signals, Domains, Claims and Dimensions, in which interpretations persist with their justifications and standing, a truth-maintenance network revises that standing as evidence changes, and validated, versioned Dimensions position interpretations on named axes. We call the result a shared organizational cortex. In a registered retrieval experiment, the Dimension term gains 0.028 nDCG@10 (p = 0.002). translated_title: 面向共享组织皮质的组合式知识架构
translated_abstract: 组织在对话、文档、决策和人际关系中积累证据，但其行动依赖于解释——即由多项观察组合而成、建立在假设之上、并随环境变化而不断修订的判断。现有的检索技术、知识图谱和智能体记忆系统只保存了记录，却丢失了解释。我们提出一个四层架构——信号、领域、主张与维度，其中解释连同其依据与立场被持久化保存；一个真值维护网络随证据变化修订这些立场；经过验证且带有版本管理的维度将解释定位于命名轴线上。我们将这一成果称为共享组织皮质。在一项注册检索实验中，维度词项带来 0.028 的 nDCG@10 提升（p = 0.002）。在系统级对比中，完整检索配置相比仅信号检索将 nDCG@10 提升 0.081，相比图增强的仅信号检索提升 0.053。
tldr: 提出由信号、领域、主张、维度四层组成的组合式知识架构，使组织解释连同其依据与立场持久保存，并通过真值维护网络随证据变化动态修订，从而显著提升检索性能。
en_tdlr: Proposes a four-layer compositional knowledge architecture (Signals, Domains, Claims, Dimensions) that persists organizational interpretations with their justifications and dynamically revises them via a truth-maintenance network, significantly improving retrieval performance.
